cards.headline: Prophetic Pattern Watch: Themes Now in the Headlines
cards.story: A doctrinal warning and a current event source share themes around voice. This can be a useful study signal, but it is not conclusive on its own.
cards.action_step: Study the cited warning in context, then pray about your personal preparation.
cards.uncertainty_note: This indicates possible alignment in themes, not proof of a fulfilled prophecy.

cards.headline: Shared Message from Apostolic Voices: Eternal, Father, Savior
cards.story: Across recent talks from the First Presidency and/or Quorum of the Twelve, the strongest repeated themes include eternal, father, savior.
cards.action_step: Pick one shared theme and turn it into a family or personal goal this week.
cards.uncertainty_note: Theme overlap is heuristic and may miss nuance; read full talks for context.

citations.title: Think Celestial!

cards.headline: From Teaching to Tuesday: One Action You Can Take Today
cards.story: A repeated doctrinal pattern points to practical discipleship: I pray that the Spirit will carry my message into your hearts today.
cards.action_step: Set aside 10 minutes daily for prayer with a specific question in mind.
cards.uncertainty_note: Application guidance is a suggested interpretation and should be personalized.
